page.overview:
Who is Casimir Ghislain?

Casimir Ghislaine, a former Bretonnian noble, was a twisted Chaos Champion of Slaanesh.

One of many champions that had flocked to Archaon's banner, Casimir wore his exquisite suffering like he wore his suit of immaculate armour. His dark plate was riven with barbs and spikes on the inside as well as on its polished surface and enclosed the Pleasure Lord’s champion like an Iron Maiden. His steed’s armour and Ghislaine’s saddle were similarly a nest of spikes to suffer upon.
